spawn_spec.prompt:
Rework /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.tsx (+ minimal wiring) so the tab-bar "+" popover matches Orca's new-tab menu exactly.

Target menu (top to bottom, each row: icon left, label, right-aligned mono shortcut):
1. New Terminal — ⌘T — existing behavior (onNewTerminal)
2. New Browser Tab — ⌘⇧B — existing behavior (onNewBrowser())
3. New Markdown — ⌘⇧M — NEW
4. New Mobile Emulator — ⌘⌥⇧E — NEW
5. Agent settings… — no shortcut — NEW

Must-do steps:
1. Add three new optional props to NewTabPopover: onNewMarkdown, onNewMobileEmulator, onOpenSettings. Render their rows only if the prop is provided. Use lucide icons close to Orca's: FileText (markdown), Smartphone (mobile emulator), Settings (agent settings).
2. In ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx where NewTabPopover is rendered, pass through three new callback props (onAddMarkdown, onAddMobileEmulator, onOpenSettings) same style as existing onAdd/onAddBrowser.
3. In ui/src/App.tsx where TabBar is used (~line 576), wire:
   - onAddMarkdown: createBrowserTab(MARKDOWN_SCRATCH_URL, "Markdown") where MARKDOWN_SCRATCH_URL is a data:text/html;charset=utf-8,... URL containing a small self-contained markdown scratch page: left textarea, right live preview rendered with a tiny built-in renderer (headings/bold/italic/code/lists/links are enough), dark background (#111), no external deps. encodeURIComponent the HTML. Define this constant in App.tsx near the other handlers.
   - onAddMobileEmulator: async — const tabId = await createBrowserTab("https://www.apple.com", "Mobile 390×844"); then find the tab's browserId from state layout (pattern exists in navigateBrowserTabAction in ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts — read it) and call setBrowserBounds(browserId, { x: <centered-in-pane>, y: 0, width: 390, height: 844 }). If finding bounds origin is unclear, use x:0,y:0,width:390,height:844 — do not overengineer. Wrap in .catch(reportRuntimeError).
   - onOpenSettings: open the existing settings dialog (find how App opens it — there is an isSettingsOpen/setIsSettingsOpen state).
4. Shortcuts shown must be display strings via the existing shortcutLabel helper pattern already used in the file; do NOT wire global keyboard shortcuts.
5. Update ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.test.tsx: adjust/add tests for the new rows rendering when props provided and hiding when absent. Run from repo root: bun run --cwd ui test -- src/components/NewTabPopover.test.tsx
6. Then verify full frontend gates: bun run --cwd ui test (whole suite must pass) and bun run --cwd ui build (exit 0).
7. NO git commit. No backend/Rust changes. Keep styling consistent with existing rows (same classNames).

Return: summary of changes + exact test counts + build result.
